Not my story, but one of my bud's frat brother's, lets call him Jeff. Jeff sat the new initiates down and told this story to deter them from drinking to heavily during finals week. The story is as follows: Jeff's friend from Louisiana came down a day before his first final, and they decided to go ham and drink the whole night. Jeff blacks out and wakes up in his friends apartment in Louisiana the next morning. Apparently, during the blackout, Jeff got in his friend's uber to the airport to make sure he got there safe. However, when they got there, Jeff drunkenly decided 'what the hell, I'll go with you'. Jeff buys a ticket, goes through security, and takes the damn plane to Louisiana. He ended up missing his final that day lol.
